account.title: Account
account.notConfigured: Sign-in is not configured on this installation.

playback.title: Playback and thumbnails
playback.subtitle: A change regenerates the previews. The old ones stay on disk until you delete them.
playback.playerVolumeHint: Shared by NetsuCut, Collections, Voice and Upscale.
playback.hoverVolumeHint: Volume of the hovered thumbnail; auto-playing previews stay muted.

generation.audioUnavailable: No audio in the configured preview.
generation.thumbnailFormatHint: At the same sharpness, a JPEG thumbnail is about twice the size of a WebP one.
generation.qualityHint: Light 360 px · Balanced 480 px · Sharp 720 px. From lightest to sharpest, a thumbnail goes from about 5 to 16 kB.

performance.shotDecodeHint: Up to 6× faster, for the same frames.
performance.vramProfileHint: Lower it if the app slows your edit down, raise it when the machine is free.
performance.maxPatchesHint: Higher catches small details, but takes more time and memory.
performance.reindexWarning: At this resolution, your clips need to be reindexed. Switching back to 256 brings back the original index, untouched.
performance.onnxGpuHint: About 8× faster. Turn it off if your graphics driver crashes.

wallpaper.title: Wallpaper
wallpaper.empty: No wallpaper yet. Drop a file here.
wallpaper.blockedByTheme: The High contrast theme doesn't support wallpaper.

colors.title: Colors
colors.resetAllHint: Removes all your changes to this theme.

custom.title: My themes
custom.subtitle: Keeps the palette, colors and wallpaper under a name.

updates.title: Updates
updates.subtitle: Releases checked on GitHub, signature verified before install.
updates.autoHint: Looks for a new version a few seconds after startup.
updates.autoInstallHint: Installs and restarts at launch, without asking.

ytdlp.hint: Library that resolves video links. Its extractors break often: it updates without waiting for the next NetsuRush release.

compatibility.title: This PC's compatibility
compatibility.cpuFunctions: Features that use the CPU or a fallback
compatibility.thumbnailEngine: Generated on the CPU by design.
compatibility.unavailable: NetsuRush could not check this PC's components.

featureHints.netsucut: Encodes previews with the available engine.
featureHints.torchModels: Detects shots, searches and improves images.
featureHints.onnxModels: Removes backgrounds and runs ONNX models.
featureHints.notebook: Saves and organizes notes. No GPU required.

power.title: Closing editing apps
power.subtitle: Offers to close Resolve or Adobe during a heavy task, then reopen your project afterward.

exportProfiles.title: Export profiles
exportProfiles.subtitle: Codec settings applied to the Download button on thumbnails and search results.
exportProfiles.restoreHint: Restores the shipped presets missing from the list.
exportProfiles.cardButtonHint: The small button that appears when you hover a thumbnail.

console.title: Console
console.subtitle: What the app, the service and the AI wrote.

bugReport.title: Report a problem
bugReport.detail: Say it in a few words
bugReport.detailPlaceholder: e.g. the Send button does nothing

categories.crash: The app closes on its own
categories.accessibility: Hard to read or to click
categories.ux: An idea to make it simpler
categories.question: I have a question

bugReport.descriptionPlaceholder: What you did, and what went wrong…
bugReport.descriptionIdeaPlaceholder: What you'd like to do, and why
bugReport.steps: How can we make it happen again?
bugReport.videoPlaceholder: a link we can download it from

validation.description: Tell us what happened before sending.
validation.detail: Say in a few words what it is about.

bugReport.noWebhook: Sending is off: no channel. Set <c1>bugWebhook</c1> in nr.config.json, or deploy the Convex relay (<c2>VITE_CONVEX_SITE_URL</c2>).
bugReport.descriptionOtherPlaceholder: Your question, or whatever you want to tell us…

outbox.intro: Anything sent to a closed app waits here, then goes out on its own when the app reopens.
outbox.delayHint: Gives the editing app time to finish opening.
outbox.targetSingleHint: All pending sends go to one timeline, created when the app reopens.
outbox.targetNewHint: Each send creates its own timeline, just like a direct send.

offline.title: Offline timeline cache
offline.none: No cache — with Resolve closed, timelines open empty.
offline.needResolve: Resolve must be connected to build the cache.
offline.building: Updating in the background (media keeps priority)…
offline.auto: Updates automatically in the background and reads only new timelines.

discord.title: Discord presence

status.searching: Can't find Discord — presence shows up once it's open.

discord.showLinksHint: The image opens the Discord server, the first line opens the repository.

storage.emptyHint: Thumbnails and previews get indexed as you browse footage.

kindHint.thumb: One image per shot. Slow to rebuild from cold.
kindHint.proxy: Short clips encoded on GPU. Rebuilt in a second.
kindHint.voice: 16 kHz WAV for transcription and silence detection.
kindHint.roto: Frames and masks from segmentation sessions.
kindHint.scenes: AI-detected cut points. Rebuild = one detection pass.
kindHint.transcripts: Text and word timings. Rebuild = one ASR pass.
kindHint.embeddings: One vector per shot — what the model saw. Rebuild = hours of GPU.
kindHint.indexThumbs: Old thumbnails stored in the index. Search now shows the ones from the cut, so you can clear what's left.
kindHint.faces: One identity vector per detected face. Rebuild = one detection pass.

tree.title: By project
tree.desc: Grouped by source folder. Clear what belongs to a finished project without touching the rest.
tree.unattributedHint: Cache written before the index, or whose footage couldn't be found. Can be purged all at once.

reindex.hint: Picks up caches already on disk: the index only knows what was written since it was introduced.

dir.title: Cache folder
dir.desc: Applies to thumbnails and video previews. The database and models stay put.
dir.moveDesc: {{size}} already sit in the old folder. Moving them saves a full rebuild.
dir.leaveHint: The old folder stays listed here and can be deleted.

lifecycle.sessionDesc: Frames, masks and tests used while current edits are in progress.
lifecycle.reusableDesc: Rebuilt on their own whenever they are missing.
lifecycle.durableDesc: Results that are costly to recompute, deleted only when you ask.

policy.title: Automatic cleanup
policy.desc: Fast previews are capped by default. Expensive analyses are kept.
policy.quotaHint: Past this, the least recently used entries go first.
policy.ageHint: Deletes anything unused for this long.
policy.manualOnlyHint: Usage isn't tracked for this type, so it can't be purged automatically.
policy.sessionDesc: When to delete heavy temporary files. Quitting the app deletes them anyway.
policy.sequenceHint: Frame folders created only to feed a model. Sequences you exported yourself are never touched.

confirm.title: Delete this cache?
confirm.descKinds: {{size}} will be freed. The content rebuilds when needed.
confirm.descUnattributed: {{size}} of unattributed cache will be freed.
confirm.expensive: The search index is included: rebuilding it takes hours of GPU.
confirm.descSources_one: {{size}} will be freed for {{count}} clip. Other footage isn't touched.
confirm.descSources_other: {{size}} will be freed for {{count}} clips. Other footage isn't touched.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.desc: Two things per-project cleanup doesn't cover.

missing.title: Missing footage
missing.desc: Unplugging an external drive is enough to make footage go missing: nothing is deleted unless you ask.

db.title: Database
db.vacuumHint: A purge leaves the space reserved in the file. Compacting gives it back to the disk.
db.vacuumBusy: Can't do this while a task is using the database. Close what's running and try again.

projects.desc: Projects that search knows about. A project is added as soon as its Media Pool is read; “Scan” finds the others.
projects.forgetTooltip: Removes the project from the list (index and files are untouched)
projects.title: Projects known to search

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: A task in progress stays on screen until it ends.
notifications.okHint: Export finished, sent to the timeline, successes in general.
notifications.errorHint: Red failure message: it asks you to act, so it stays longer.
notifications.badgeHint: Red badge in the bottom-right corner. Errors stay readable in the console.

detection.reindexHint: Switching model means reindexing your clips.

indexing.title: Indexing
indexing.subtitle: Each clip is cut into shots, then each shot is analyzed. Anything that doesn't change the result is already on.

boardAssets.title: Board storage
boardAssets.intro: What the app keeps for itself: pasted images, media from links, frames, upscale results. Your own files are never touched.
boardAssets.failed: That didn't go through. Try again.
boardAssets.archivedNotice: Board saved to “{{name}}”: its media now live in the project folder
boardAssets.settlingHint: A file written moments ago may belong to an import the board has not placed yet. It will be checked on the next pass.

safe.hint: Checked file by file: these files can be rebuilt, or already exist inside a project folder.
safe.title: Safe to free
safe.duplicated: Media already filed in a project ({{count}})
safe.duplicatedHint: The files are already in a project's folder, for example “{{project}}”.

sole.title: Save these somewhere first
sole.hint: This is the only copy: save the board first, and it moves to the section above.
sole.empty: Nothing at risk: everything the app keeps also exists elsewhere.
sole.sharedHint: A shared board has no project version: its document is authoritative and collaboration handles its media.
sole.openBoardHint: This board is open: use “Save as…” from its toolbar.
sole.sceneCount_one: {{count}} media file only the app holds · {{size}}
sole.sceneCount_other: {{count}} media files only the app holds · {{size}}
sole.orphansHint_one: {{count}} file · {{size}}. Nothing displays it anymore, but this is the only copy.
sole.orphansHint_other: {{count}} files · {{size}}. Nothing displays them anymore, but this is the only copy.

collaboration.title: Collaboration
collaboration.description: Specific to this computer. One profile for everything, or an exception per page type.
collaboration.profilesHint: Live: sends every 60 ms. Balanced: 200 ms. Economy: 900 ms, with automatic media downloads disabled.
collaboration.saveFailed: Couldn't save settings on this computer.
